name: DRO-B
about: DRO-B (2024-048D, CASC/CSUCAS), launched 2024 Mar 13. Its phases from GCAT: Luna. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was
